title: Rosenfeld: Like U (Lyric Video)
description: A cinematic lyric video for Rosenfeld's Like U.
overview: Like U translates Rosenfeld's track into a cinematic lyric-led visual world. The film combines atmospheric motion, type and image to give the song a distinct visual identity.
The visual language moves with the music, holding on mood and detail while making space for the lyrics to lead the experience.
